name: Music Studio
description: Take a song idea to sketches, an arrangement, stems and a mix with ElevenLabs Music or Lyria, then master it, prepare it for DJing (BPM, key, beatgrid, cues, crates), make a music video (treatment, storyboard, clips with Gemini, an edit cut to the beat with karaoke captions) and deliver stems, masters, rekordbox files, the video and a vertical cut. Every paid step waits for your confirm; mastering, preparing, editing, rendering and delivering run on this computer.

llm.why: Writes a first description of each shot in the Storyboard from your concept and the song's sections. You can edit or replace every description; if you refuse, they are left blank for you to write.

panels.label: Music Studio
panels.description: Go to your Music Studio session, or start one: the studio opens beside its chat

launch.label: Music Studio
launch.description: A session with the Music Studio beside the chat

settings.label: ElevenLabs key
settings.description: From elevenlabs.io, Developers, API keys. Used for Music v2.5 and to show your credits.

settings.label: Gemini key
settings.description: From aistudio.google.com, Get API key. Used for Lyria 3 Clip and Lyria 3.5, for reading shared pictures and videos (source material: a few cents), and for the video stages: still frames (Gemini 3.1 Flash Image) and clips (Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash). Video needs a paid tier (billing on).

settings.label: ffmpeg path
settings.description: Mix, Master, Prepare, Deliver and the video Edit use ffmpeg. Leave empty to use ffmpeg from the PATH.

settings.label: Video budget (USD)
settings.description: Default dollars a project may spend on its music video (pictures and clips; estimates from Google's prices). Each project can set its own on the Treatment stage. Shooting stops when it is reached.

settings.label: Library folder
settings.description: Where each project's folder is kept. Made on the first sketch.
